answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that unlocks only after a history of useful work, like a sonnet that takes time to compose rather than copy. A newcomer starts in a sable-dark probation pool where its actions are rate-limited and peer-reviewed; only verified work moves it onto the open reef of the economy, where reputations are public and costly to rebuild. A thousand sock puppets then cost a thousand deposits and a thousand slow probations, while one honest agent pays once.
